title: Missing Basic Features Available in the Web Version
body: I really like Cursor and use it regularly to manage AI coding agents remotely. However, the iOS app feels incomplete compared to the web version. Basic features such as copying an entire AI response, giving thumbs-up or thumbs-down feedback, and forking a conversation are readily available in the browser but appear to be missing from the iOS app. It’s frustrating that I have to switch to Safari just to access these simple functions, especially when working with agents remotely from my iPhone. The app has great potential, but it needs feature parity with the web version. Please bring these essential controls to the native iOS app. They would make a huge difference to the user experience.
